name: papercuts
description: Give your agent a complaint box: file, list, resolve, and remove papercuts in an append-only journal at the repository root

interface.shortDescription: A complaint box for agents: log friction, review it, fix root causes
interface.longDescription: Papercuts gives coding agents a one-command way to log workflow friction — dead-end tool calls, broken links, misleading docs, footgun configs — into an append-only .papercuts.jsonl journal at the repository root. A companion review skill turns validated complaints into durable fixes. The journal is repo-scoped and shared across agents.
defaultPrompt: File a papercut about the last thing that slowed you down, then keep working
Review the open papercuts and turn them into durable fixes
